name: Taparia BC-18 Heavy Duty Drop Forged Carbon Steel Bolt Cutter (18-Inch)
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 450mm bolt cutter with drop-forged high-grade chrome vanadium steel cutting blades and compound toggle leverage for slicing 8mm steel rods and padlocks.
overview: The Taparia BC-18 is a rugged, drop-forged 18-inch (450mm) bolt cutter engineered to slice effortlessly through high-tensile bolts, structural rebar, chains, padlocks, and wire fencing. Forged from high-grade alloy steel and induction hardened to 56-60 HRC, the cutting blades feature a compound toggle-joint linkage that converts modest hand force into tremendous shearing power at the jaws. Built with heavy-walled tubular steel handles that resist flexing under full operator weight, it features cushioned rubber grips with slip-stop flanges for secure handling.
keyFeatures: Drop-forged Chrome Vanadium / Carbon Alloy steel cutting blades
Induction hardened cutting edges (56 – 60 HRC) resist nicks and deformation
Compound leverage toggle joint delivers exceptional mechanical mechanical advantage
Cuts through mild steel rods, wire mesh, concrete rebar, and padlocks up to 8mm
Eccentric bolt adjustment system allows precision realignment of worn blade edges
Heavy-walled tubular steel handles withstand massive manual shearing torque
Durable ergonomic non-slip rubber grips provide comfortable two-handed leverage

applications: Cutting structural rebar and welded wire mesh on concrete job sites

Fencing installation, high-tensile wire rope, and cable cutting
Scrap metal processing, salvage operations, and workshop demolition
